result.question: Why did David’s men swear that he must never again go out with them to battle?

readings.answer: So that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.
readings.support: so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished

readings.answer: Because David had just been in mortal danger and needed rescue (Ishbi-benob resolved to kill him and Abishai had to help).
readings.support: resolved to kill David | Then David’s men swore to him

assessments.reason: It directly quotes the stated purpose in the verse: “so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”

The sequence shows Ishbi-benob tried to kill David, Abishai rescued him, then they swore, so it’s a reasonable motivation even though the verse’s stated reason is “so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”
